comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district entry signs. Coordinates are real-world lat/lon projected into world space via Road.project(). radius = trigger distance in compressed-world meters. Entries marked needs_owner_review need confirmation from the owner's lived knowledge — map data may be approximate.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The airport spit — sea on both sides, coconut trees lining the road.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Harbour View roundabout — where Windward Road begins.

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: Capital and largest city of Jamaica.

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major intersection linking Half Way Tree and downtown.

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Commercial hub of uptown Kingston — the 1813 clock tower marks the crossroads.

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's old colonial capital, St Catherine parish.

communities.name: Angels
communities.note: Small community between Spanish Town and Bog Walk.

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Gateway to the Rio Cobre gorge.

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Lively market town — 'Linstead Market, couldn't sell a quattie worth a ackee.'

communities.name: Mount Rosser
communities.note: Hill community on the approach to Moneague.

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Crossroads town at the top of the hill — right turn for Ocho Rios.

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival.

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Three kilometres of lush ferns and bamboo canopy — one of Jamaica's most iconic roads.

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Major north coast resort town. Cruise ships, waterfalls, and jerk stands.
